description: Agent-based diffusion model for behavior/adoption dynamics over a social network with peer influence and exogenous media/policy signals. The model simulates daily interactions, belief updates, and adoption decisions, producing observable adoption rates and incidence (new adopters) suitable for calibration and prediction.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the static social network and assigns group/community structure and edge weights.

notes: Assortativity achieved by biasing intra-group edge formation
Clustering bias tweaks triadic closure during generation

modules.name: AttributeInitializer
modules.description: Initializes agent-level attributes (beliefs, thresholds, stubbornness, trust, adoption state) using specified distributions and network-informed features.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  for each node i in graph:
    group_id[i] = assigned group
    stubbornness[i] ~ truncate(N(stubbornness_mean, stubbornness_std), 0, 1)
    threshold[i] ~ truncate(N(adoption_threshold_mean, adoption_threshold_std), 0, 1)
    trust_media[i] ~ truncate(N(trust_media_mean, trust_media_std), 0, 1)
    belief[i] ~ truncate(N(initial_belief_mean, initial_belief_std), 0, 1)
    adoption_state[i] ~ Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate)
    time_since_adoption[i] = 0 if adoption_state[i]==1 else -1
  output agents.state
notes: Initial adopters seeded at random according to initial_adoption_rate

modules.name: MediaPolicyEngine
modules.description: Generates a daily exogenous media/policy signal that influences agents, including campaigns, counter-misinformation, and policy nudges.

notes: Signal is capped by max_media_reach_fraction to reflect limited reach
policy.nudge_targets is an index set of agents receiving nudges

modules.name: InfluenceDynamics
modules.description: Simulates daily peer-to-peer interactions, media processing, belief updates, and adoption decisions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each day t:
  daily_new = 0
  for each agent i:
    # neighbor interaction sampling
    neighbors = graph.neighbors(i)
    k = ceil(base_contact_rate * len(neighbors))
    S = sample_without_replacement(neighbors, k)
    peer_signal = 0
    denom = 0
    for j in S:
      s_j = 1 if adoption_state[j]==1 and Bernoulli(share_probability)==1 else 0
      w_ij = edge_weight(i,j)
      peer_signal += w_ij * s_j
      denom += w_ij
    peer_signal = peer_signal / max(1e-9, denom)
    # media processing
    media_input = media_influence_weight * (trust_media[i] * media.signal_t)
    # belief update (DeGroot-like with stubbornness and memory decay)
    decay = exp(-ln(2) / decay_memory_halflife_days)
    social_input = peer_influence_weight * peer_signal
    new_belief = (1 - stubbornness[i]) * (decay * belief[i] + (1 - decay) * (social_input + media_input)) + stubbornness[i] * belief[i]
    # noise
    new_belief = clamp(new_belief + Normal(0, adoption_noise_scale), 0, 1)
    belief[i] = new_belief
  # policy nudges: temporarily lower threshold or boost belief
  for i in policy.nudge_targets:
    belief[i] = clamp(belief[i] + 0.1, 0, 1)
  # adoption decision
  for each agent i not yet adopted:
    hazard = sigmoid((belief[i] - adoption_threshold[i]) / 0.1)
    hazard = clamp(hazard * max(0.01, media_influence_weight + peer_influence_weight), 0, 1)
    if Bernoulli(hazard)==1:
      adoption_state[i] = 1
      time_since_adoption[i] = 0
      daily_new += 1
  # aging adopters
  for each agent i with adoption_state[i]==1:
    time_since_adoption[i] += 1
  output agents.state_updated and flow.daily_new_adopters = daily_new
notes: Belief update balances stubbornness, memory decay, peer and media influences
share_probability models willingness of adopters to broadcast to neighbors

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables (adoption rate, incidence) with optional reporting delay and measurement noise.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each day t:
  N = population_size
  adoption_rate = mean_i(adoption_state[i])
  new_adopters = flow.daily_new_adopters
  cumulative = cumulative_previous + new_adopters
  # reporting delay: store in buffer and emit delayed values
  buffer.push((t, adoption_rate, new_adopters, cumulative))
  if buffer.size > reporting_delay_days:
    emit_day, ar, na, cum = buffer.pop_oldest()
    noisy_ar = clamp(ar + Normal(0, measurement_noise_std), 0, 1)
    noisy_na = max(0, round(na + Normal(0, measurement_noise_std * N)))
    noisy_cum = max(0, round(cum + Normal(0, measurement_noise_std * N)))
    output observable.adoption_rate_daily = (emit_day, noisy_ar)
    output observable.new_adopters_daily = (emit_day, noisy_na)
    output observable.cumulative_adopters = (emit_day, noisy_cum)
notes: Measurement noise scaled differently for rates vs counts
Reporting delay simulates lag in observed data

algorithms.network_generation: Erdos-Renyi / Barabasi-Albert / Watts-Strogatz graph construction with assortativity and clustering bias
algorithms.belief_update: DeGroot-style averaging with memory decay and stubbornness, plus Gaussian noise
algorithms.adoption_decision: Thresholded logistic hazard based on belief relative to personal threshold
algorithms.media_signal: Gaussian or triangular campaign profile added to baseline and reduced by counter-misinformation
algorithms.aggregation: Delayed noisy reporting of daily adoption rate and incidence
